title: All employee names
description: List the name of every employee.

title: Name and salary
description: Return the name and salary of every employee.

title: Distinct locations
description: List each department location once, with no duplicates. Return a single column: location.

title: Salary after a raise
description: Return each employee's name and a column called raised_salary equal to their salary plus 5000.
expected_query: SELECT name, salary + 5000 AS raised_salary FROM employees;
